readings: Join signals to their telescopes and observatories, excluding signals without a match. For each telescope and weather profile, calculate the average modulation index and average phase shift. Use the average modulation index across all matched signals as the overall average. Keep only telescope/weather groups whose average modulation index exceeds it. For each weather profile, report the unweighted average of the retained groups’ average modulation indices, the unweighted average of their average phase shifts, and the unweighted average of their modulation-index differences from the overall average. Do not round.

Join signals to their telescopes and observatories, excluding signals without a match. For each telescope and weather profile, calculate the average modulation index and average phase shift. Use the unweighted average of the telescope/weather groups’ average modulation indices as the overall average. Keep only groups whose average modulation index exceeds it. For each weather profile, report the unweighted average of the retained groups’ average modulation indices, the unweighted average of their average phase shifts, and the unweighted average of their modulation-index differences from the overall average. Do not round.
queries:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM matched
),
telescope_weather AS (
    SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile,
           AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex,
           AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile
)
SELECT tw.weathprofile,
       AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
       AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phase_shift,
       AVG(tw.avg_modindex - overall.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index_difference
FROM telescope_weather AS tw
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE tw.avg_modindex > overall.avg_modindex
GROUP BY tw.weathprofile

WITH telescope_weather AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
        AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM telescope_weather
)
SELECT
    tw.weathprofile,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex - overall.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_difference
FROM telescope_weather AS tw
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE tw.avg_modindex > overall.avg_modindex
GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
